newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Cable thief diables phones across Russian region.
newsitem.headline: Cable thief diables phones across Russian region.

text.p: A thief removing 60 metres (yards) of cable from the centre of a remote Russian city shut down external communications for five hours on Thursday, Itar-Tass news agency reported.

The incident in the Republic of Buryatiya's capital Ulan-Ude bordering Mongolia affected the military as well as other communications in the region and caused an estimated loss of 800 million roubles ($135,000).
Tass said the criminal or criminals may have been seeking to steal precious metal from the lines.
Earlier this week two thieves were electrocuted in eastern Kazakhstan as they tried to steal copper wires from a high-voltage electricity transmission line.
